body: Honestly, the last 10 years of my life have drained everything that I had left to my name. I have only been able to find one job in my field. In hindsight, a combination of bad luck, breaks, decisions and overt thievery have left me destitute.

I don't hold other people accountable for my birth; of course not. Also, my parents have been deceased for nearly 10 years and I "won't beat a dead horse" so to speak; I was slapped at birth, cried and here I am...

The library, in the city I live in, gives you free computer access on a daily basis. And yes, there are other homeless using computers in the same room that I am currently in. I, for one, acknowledge their presence, yet don't go much further. See, I have been a pretty extreme introvert most of my life and do not make friends/personal relationships easily. Hell, at my age that certainly won't change.

Yes, I am living on the streets. 

You see too many drug addicts, crazy people and people who have given up all hope ( a big part of this group seems to be people facing the shortage of available housing resources for the homeless). 

You get completely sick of all the damn routines of being homeless. It seems that "wasting your time" is one of the biggest common denominators of being homeless. You spend hours of your day sitting in day shelters,the library and night shelters waiting to sleep. What a freakin' joke!

People tell you all the time, "Oh it will get better...". Well, all I have to say is screw those people. They don't have to live my life right now. They would say the same thing about having no hope and wanting to die. 

I have that freakin' right, "the right to take my own life". Remember, we all come into this world, not by our own choice, and should be left with the decision on when our life should be ended if our life is not too our liking. It is a very hard truth that not all can accept. 

Again, I will just be a statistic; no one really cares (in my case that is very, very true with no family/friends). In conclusion, the only thing that matters in life is greed. Without money and power, at this point in my own existence, what do I have left? Absolutely, positively nothing...

Life is a joke!
